topic: Charity shop finds: how I stopped buying books I already own

tiktok.hook_text: You bought it twice again, didn't you?
tiktok.body_text: We've all been there at the charity shop or record fair—is this already on my shelf? SeniorEase Library keeps track of your entire collection with one simple scan. No accounts, no fuss, no surprises. Just peace of mind for €4.99, once.
tiktok.caption: Stop the duplicate hunt. One scan, total control. 📚 Your collection deserves better. #SeniorEase #BookCollector #VinylLife #NoMoreDuplicates

linkedin: Collecting is a passion—but it comes with a hidden cost. Every month, collectors spend money on items they already own. At the charity shop. At the record fair. At the boot sale. You forget what's on your shelf, and duplicates slip through. The frustration? Real. The waste? Avoidable. SeniorEase Library solves this with elegant simplicity: scan your collection once, carry it with you always. No cloud. No account. No subscription. Just your collection, your way, protected on your device. €4.99, paid once. Designed for people who respect their collections—and their privacy. Because collecting should bring joy, not buyer's remorse. Discover SeniorEase Library at seniorease.eu. #Collecting #PrivacyFirst #SimpleDesign
